annotations.text:
Tabs are gone. The form is one scroll with a section index down the left, the way the VS Code Settings editor works, and fields sit in two columns instead of one.

Click a section to jump. The dot beside Transport is the live security reading: tick trust the certificate and watch it fall from teal to amber.

Test connection: Billing-DB succeeds, Ledger-Core fails on the certificate, Warehouse-QA is refused at login. Connect runs the same test.

The theme chip flips the page to light.

Below 760px the connections rail becomes a picker and the section index becomes a scrolling chip strip. Fields drop to one column.

This is the width people actually get when the page opens beside a query editor.

Five colour systems, each with its own shape so they never compete: engine mark, environment bar, transport chip, result strip, product accent.

Everything neutral comes from a VS Code theme token. The engine marks are placeholders. Drop the vendor artwork in at build time.
